mitre_mappings.justification: Abusing trusted developer utilities to proxy execution is a clear abuse of functionality.
Abusing software extensions to execute malicious code is a direct abuse of functionality.
Abusing IDE extensions to execute malicious code is a direct abuse of functionality.
Verclsid is a signed binary that can be abused to execute code, representing an abuse of functionality.
Abuse of elevation control mechanisms to gain higher privileges is a direct abuse of system functionality.
Using system services to execute code abuses legitimate system functionality.

veris_to_mitre.notes: Selected techniques that directly involve abusing legitimate system features or tools for malicious purposes.

mitre_mappings.justification: Directly corresponds to the Adversary-in-the-Middle attack, which is the exact capability described.

veris_to_mitre.notes: Only the parent technique T1557 is available in the candidate list; sub-techniques are not included.
